evidence_notes: All eleven mandatory-matrix runs plus five supplementary probes passed exact same-environment source-bound replay before any source edits.
Detailed per-element budgets, snapshots and self-contained baseline sessions are retained under work/checkpoint-a.
Numerical margin is radial slack of the full conservative corner enclosure; it must not be read as a scalar directional travel allowance.
Rejections did not mutate state, channels, events, captures, mode, target identity or trajectory digest.
